# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 97 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 97 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_097_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 14

**1** "All these," he said, "are glorious angels. With these the Lord is surrounded. But the gate is the Son of God; this is the one entrance to the Lord. **2** No one shall enter in to the Lord except through him. Do not think that anyone can enter in other than through the Son." **3** I said, "I understand, Lord. But the six men who carried the stones — who are they?" **4** "These are the six holy angels of God who preside over all virtues, which are the first created by God; to these the Lord delivered the whole creation to increase and build up. Through these six angels the tower is completed." **5** "But who are the others who are bringing stones?" I asked. **6** "These too are holy angels of the Lord; but the six are over them. When the building of the tower is completed, all of them will feast together in the presence of the Lord. **7** They shall rejoice with the Lord for having finished the tower." **8** I said, "Lord, I want to know what the stones are and what they signify." **9** "The square white stones that fit perfectly together — these are the apostles and bishops and teachers and deacons who walked in the holiness of God, who governed and taught and ministered to the elect of God with purity and reverence. **10** Some of them have fallen asleep and some are still living. They always agreed with one another and were at peace with one another, and on account of this their joints with one another are exact — a perfect fit in the building of the tower."

---

*EMET: the six chief angels presiding over virtues and creation. The four-fold ministry (apostles, bishops, teachers, deacons) is one of the earliest attestations of this ecclesiastical structure.*
